report:
Reviewed the complete claim, sole ordinary implementation association (sage_ir::tytree), and sole TODO test sage_meta::todo::types_body_resolved_references. Independently verified exact byte equality of both current source files against historical implementation_sources/test_sources; historical rationale is consistent with current inputs, but is not substituted for this assessment.

The claim covers every path, field, variant, function and associated-item reference specifically in successful completed bodies. PathResolution stores Def(Symbol) or Local(LocalId), with Error(ErrorReported) explicitly representing failed resolution. Expression and pattern paths and struct/tuple-struct references use Res. ResolvedField carries struct/variant owner identity plus index; ResolvedCallTarget carries function identity and trait dispatch context. These provide concrete identity-bearing representations, not proof of exhaustive successful-body resolution. The same file permits name-only MethodCall, named initializer/pattern fields, Missing and Unresolved nodes. Consequently complete-body traversal and rejection/normalization of unresolved references, including nested expressions and patterns and associated items, remains the explicit deferred obligation; error recovery must be distinguished from successful completion.

The only annotated test has no assertions. Its TODO explicitly requires a whole-tree validator rejecting every unresolved semantic reference and unsupported placeholder. That prerequisite adequately preserves the universal gap for all five reference categories: implement the validator/completion boundary and provide successful-body identity checks and negative unresolved/placeholder scenarios before treating this claim as fully verified. The placeholder would not detect an unresolved method or nested path escaping completion; no behavioral coverage is claimed. Accepting this documented deferral requests no additional edits and leaves TODO visible.

Source inspection and baseline byte comparison only. Executed review start and review read (review policy), and recording this report; no behavioral tests or cargo build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 passing sage-meta tests and a passing root build, which do not establish this deferred guarantee.
